tools.name: get_profile
tools.title: Get the mailbox profile
tools.description: Return the connected mailbox's email address and its message and thread totals, for example {"emailAddress": "alice@example.com", "messagesTotal": 1532, "threadsTotal": 811}. Use it to learn which mailbox is connected.

tools.name: search_threads
tools.title: Search threads
tools.description: Search the mailbox's threads and return their ids and snippets, newest first. q uses Gmail search syntax, for example `from:alice@example.com is:unread newer_than:7d` or `subject:invoice has:attachment`; leave it out to list the latest threads. labelIds keeps only threads with all of those labels (ids from list_labels, such as INBOX). Pass nextPageToken back as pageToken for the next page.

labelIds.description: Label ids from list_labels, such as INBOX or Label_12; a thread must have all of them.

maxResults.description: Threads per page, 1-500 (default 100). Use 10-25 for a first look.

q.description: Gmail search query, for example `from:alice@example.com is:unread` or `after:2026/10/01 has:attachment`.

tools.name: get_thread
tools.title: Read a thread
tools.description: Read every message of one thread by its id (from search_threads), oldest first. format=metadata returns headers only (pick them with metadataHeaders, for example From, To, Subject, Date); format=full also returns the bodies, base64url-encoded in payload.parts[].body.data.

id.description: Thread id from search_threads, for example 18c2f0d7a1b2c3d4.

format.description: The format to return the messages in.

metadataHeaders.description: With format=metadata, the headers to return, for example From, Subject and Date.

tools.name: get_message
tools.title: Read a message
tools.description: Read one message by its id, for example 18c2f0d7a1b2c3d4. format=metadata returns headers only; format=full returns the body parts, base64url-encoded; format=raw returns the whole RFC 2822 message in raw. Before replying, read the parent with format=metadata and metadataHeaders Message-ID, References and Subject: the reply needs them.

id.description: Message id from get_thread or search results, for example 18c2f0d7a1b2c3d4.

format.description: The format to return the message in.

metadataHeaders.description: With format=metadata, the headers to return, for example Message-ID, References and Subject.

tools.name: list_labels
tools.title: List labels
tools.description: List the mailbox's labels with their ids: system labels such as INBOX, SENT, UNREAD and STARRED, and the user's own, such as Label_12. Use the ids with search_threads, label_thread and unlabel_thread.

tools.name: list_drafts
tools.title: List drafts
tools.description: List saved drafts with their ids and message ids, newest first. q filters them with Gmail search syntax, for example `subject:proposal`. Pass nextPageToken back as pageToken for the next page.

q.description: Gmail search query over the drafts, for example `to:bob@example.com`.

tools.name: create_draft
tools.title: Create a draft
tools.description:
Save a draft without sending it. message.raw is the whole RFC 2822 message, base64url-encoded, for example the encoding of "To: bob@example.com
Subject: Hello

Hi Bob". To draft a reply, set message.threadId to the thread's id, put In-Reply-To and References headers with the parent's Message-ID in the message, and keep its Subject (read them with get_message first). Returns the draft id for send_draft.

message.description: The message content of the draft.

raw.description: The entire email message in an RFC 2822 formatted and base64url encoded string. Returned in `messages.get` and `drafts.get` responses when the `format=RAW` parameter is supplied. @required gmail.users.drafts.create gmail.users.drafts.update

threadId.description: The ID of the thread the message belongs to. To add a message or draft to a thread, the following criteria must be met: 1. The requested `threadId` must be specified on the `Message` or `Draft.Message` you supply with your request. 2. The `References` and `In-Reply-To` headers must be set in compliance with the [RFC 2822](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc2822) standard. 3. The `Subject` headers must match.

tools.name: send_draft
tools.title: Send a draft
tools.description: Send a draft saved earlier, by the id create_draft or list_drafts returned, for example r-5108413232411426193. The draft is removed and the sent message is returned.

id.description: The immutable ID of the draft.

tools.name: send_message
tools.title: Send a message
tools.description:
Send an email. raw is the whole RFC 2822 message, base64url-encoded, for example the encoding of "To: bob@example.com
Subject: Hello

Hi Bob". To reply in a thread, set threadId to the thread's id, put In-Reply-To and References headers with the parent's Message-ID in the message, and keep its Subject (read them with get_message first); otherwise Gmail starts a new thread.

raw.description: The entire email message in an RFC 2822 formatted and base64url encoded string. Returned in `messages.get` and `drafts.get` responses when the `format=RAW` parameter is supplied. @required gmail.users.drafts.create gmail.users.drafts.update

threadId.description: The ID of the thread the message belongs to. To add a message or draft to a thread, the following criteria must be met: 1. The requested `threadId` must be specified on the `Message` or `Draft.Message` you supply with your request. 2. The `References` and `In-Reply-To` headers must be set in compliance with the [RFC 2822](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc2822) standard. 3. The `Subject` headers must match.

tools.name: label_thread
tools.title: Add labels to a thread
tools.description: Add labels to every message of a thread, by label id from list_labels, for example addLabelIds=["STARRED"] or ["Label_12"]. Adding a label the thread already has changes nothing.

addLabelIds.description: A list of IDs of labels to add to this thread. You can add up to 100 labels with each update.

tools.name: unlabel_thread
tools.title: Remove labels from a thread
tools.description: Remove labels from every message of a thread, by label id from list_labels: removing UNREAD marks it read, removing INBOX archives it. Removing a label the thread does not have changes nothing.

removeLabelIds.description: A list of IDs of labels to remove from this thread. You can remove up to 100 labels with each update.

tools.name: create_label
tools.title: Create a label
tools.description: Create a label of the user's own, for example name="Receipts" or a nested "Clients/Acme". Returns its id for label_thread.

name.description: The display name of the label.

labelListVisibility.description: The visibility of the label in the label list in the Gmail web interface.

messageListVisibility.description: The visibility of messages with this label in the message list in the Gmail web interface.

tools.name: trash_thread
tools.title: Move a thread to the trash
tools.description: Move every message of a thread to the trash, by thread id from search_threads.
